name: Mr. Heater Big Maxx Natural Gas Garage/Workshop Unit Heater - 80,000 BTU, Model MHU80NG
description: This Mr. Heater Big Maxx Natural Gas Garage/Workshop Unit Heater is quiet and vented for easily heating a 2- to 3-car garage. The low-profile design requires only 1in. clearance from the ceiling two angle brackets are included. Big Maxx features power exhaust for vertical or horizontal venting. Use right or left side piping, electrical and flue connections by simply rotating 180. Big Maxx includes an aluminum tubular heat exchanger for maximum efficiency and longer life. Handy extras include spark ignition with a self-diagnostic control module and easy outside access to the thermostat and AC terminals.
